note: #2767 item 2 (plural possessive apostrophe indistinguishable from a closing quote): the possessive apostrophe in "modules' configs" is immediately followed by whitespace, exactly like a genuine closing quote, so `isFollowedByFramingVerb`'s bare indexOf("'") scan treats it as the closer and never reaches the real one before "Alice reports"; the genuine attribution is missed and the decision is wrongly counted as live. Same underlying mechanism as item 1's finding; the gap is present today (MATCH).
title: Update module configs
body:
Whether this design reads well is ultimately a matter of maintainer preference.

'Maintainer decision (#100, 2026-09-01): update the modules' configs. Keep them synced,' Alice reports.
